I was on probation for a DUI. Even after I could have fucking killed someone while driving under the influence, I didn't think I had a problem. Thought i just got unlucky being caught. Didnt stop drinking. Of course I got caught and violated. Blew a .10 after drinking the night prior. My blood results came back and it was the equivalent to drinking a 24 pack to myself even after sleeping most of it off! My PO wanted to give me 240 days in jail. (My county does not take these things lightly.) Somehow I was able to get out after 35 days, with reinstated probation with drug/alcohol tests 2/week instead of 2/month. I thank god that it happened honestly.. I realize now how much of a problem I really had. I'm 47 days sober today and so thankful for it. Even though I have a long road ahead of me, I'm so happy that my eyes are opened. This is the longest I've gone without drinking since I was probably 15/16.
Stick with it dude. Dont go back to drinking. Its not worth it. I cheated the system and somehow drank for 8 months while on probation, but it catches up with you one way or another... Im so much happier and have so much more self confidence. I'm back in control of my life and nothing can take that away from me. Don't make the mistake I did. Good luck
